senses.sense_definition: Elements, interpretations, or backstories of a fictional universe that a fan personally believes to be true, despite not being confirmed by the official work.

examples.text: In my personal <w>headcanon</w>, the two characters eventually reunited and traveled the world together.
Many fans share the same <w>headcanon</w> regarding how the villain acquired his mysterious powers.

traits.comment: used primarily in fandom communities and internet culture

senses.sense_definition: To personally accept or interpret a character, event, or detail in a fictional universe in a specific way that is not officially confirmed.

examples.text: Many readers <w>headcanon</w> the detective as neurodivergent because of his particular habits.
She <w>headcanons</w> that the sidekick secretly planned the entire escape without anyone knowing.

traits.comment: used primarily in fandom communities and internet culture
